snippet.title: Zeroth - Official Trailer
snippet.description:
Guide fallen heroes through a post-life adventure in the absurd and ever-changing 0th circle of Haell. Exploit the sandbox physics and experiment with mysterious treasure to postpone your inevitable death. Emergent chaos and exasperated heroes, only in Zeroth.

Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4062680/Zeroth/

#indiegame #roguelike #adventure #platformer #steam 

Music is 'Fate and Fortune' by Scott Buckley – released under CC-BY 4.0. Available at www.scottbuckley.com.au
